project.name: Code review follow-ups
project.description: Work found in the full-repository review of 2026-11-13: red CI checks, security and robustness gaps, unwired pieces, missing tests, maintainability and stale docs.

milestones.title: M0: Get CI green
milestones.description: Both jobs in .github/workflows/verify.yml fail on main today.

tasks.title: Fix the stale self-tests for the model-SDK check
tasks.description: scripts/test_check_no_model_in_server.py: two tests still expect allowances (Bedrock control plane in agents/catalog.ts, `openai` in the runtime manifest) that scripts/check-no-model-in-server.py no longer grants. The check passes; its tests do not, so `bun run check:models` exits 1.

tasks.title: Rename the `module` variable in preview-frame.tsx
tasks.description: frontend/components/common/issues/details/preview-frame.tsx:144 trips @next/next/no-assign-module-variable and fails `bun run lint`.

tasks.title: Remove the text-sm utility in session-gate.tsx
tasks.description: frontend/components/layout/session-gate.tsx:47 breaks the font-size rule (no-restricted-syntax) and fails `bun run lint`.

tasks.title: Add .next-desktop-bundle to the ESLint ignores
tasks.description: The directory is gitignored but linted, so a local `bun run lint` reports 2,446 errors from build output and buries real ones.

milestones.title: M1: Security and robustness
milestones.description: Gaps found while reading the request path and outbound calls.

tasks.title: Add rate limiting to the HTTP API
tasks.description: No limiter exists anywhere in server-ts/src. Cover at least the public /v1 API, /api/webhooks/autopilots/:token and /api/v1/previews/:token/*.

tasks.title: Refuse private addresses in MCP server URLs
tasks.description: server-ts/src/mounts/mcp-servers.ts:20 only checks for http(s). Trace where the URL is fetched to confirm exposure, then reuse the address guards in runtime/agent-tools/fetch-url.ts or plugins/net.ts.

tasks.title: Resolve the dependency audit findings
tasks.description: `bun audit` reports 1 high (decode-uri-component) and 3 moderate (decode-uri-component, glob, minimatch), mostly through electron-builder, Storybook, Expo and @livekit/agents.

tasks.title: Review the silent `.catch(() => undefined)` sites in the server
tasks.description: About 124 in non-test server code. Some are deliberate; others hide permanent failures, e.g. the preview reaper at server-ts/src/index.ts:377. Log at minimum.

milestones.title: M2: Unwired and half-finished pieces
milestones.description: Code that exists and is tested but is not connected, and deferred scope that needs a decision.

tasks.title: Wire the Valkey relay or delete it
tasks.description: server-ts/src/index.ts:335 constructs Distributed(hub, null). realtime/relay.ts is tested but unused, so events arrive only on the ~500 ms poll.

tasks.title: Decide the fate of BERRY_RUNTIME_DRIVER
tasks.description: server-ts/src/config/config.ts:517 parses and validates it (including Docker URL and token requirements) but nothing selects a driver from it. Wire it or remove the parsing.

tasks.title: Drop or restore the deferred routes and decide on Automations
tasks.description: server-ts/SCOPE.md lists POST /projects/:id/generated-issues and POST /agents/:id/ask as unregistered, and /workflows, /workflow-runs, /hooks as unserved. Remove the leftovers or schedule them.

tasks.title: Add frontend tests to CI
tasks.description: There are no frontend test files. 291 Storybook stories and a vitest.config.ts with the Storybook plugin exist, but there is no `test` script and CI never runs them.

tasks.title: Cover the largest untested server files
tasks.description: No sibling test file: mounts/integrations.ts (1,830 lines), mounts/projects.ts, mounts/issues.ts, mounts/agents.ts, identity/secrets.ts, core/projects.ts. Check for indirect coverage first.

tasks.title: Run plugin, desktop and VS Code tests in CI
tasks.description: test:plugins, typecheck:plugins and the tests in apps/desktop and apps/vscode are not in verify.yml. apps/mobile and apps/web have no tests.

tasks.title: Make DB-backed tests easy to run locally
tasks.description: 140 suites skip silently without BERRY_TEST_DATABASE_URL. Add a script that creates the schema-only copy described in server-ts/ROUTING.md.

tasks.title: Split the composition root
tasks.description: server-ts/src/index.ts is 1,805 lines of hand wiring. Split into per-area composition functions without adding a DI container.

tasks.title: Break up the largest frontend components
tasks.description: issue-artifacts.tsx (1,470), transcript-dialog.tsx (1,355), command-palette.tsx (1,156), activity-feed.tsx (1,154).

tasks.title: Audit hard-coded colours against the semantic tokens
tasks.description: A rough grep finds about 166 hex or palette-class usages outside components/ui/. See docs/design-system.md.

tasks.title: Revisit the react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressions
tasks.description: 16 suppressions in frontend source.

tasks.title: Narrow the non-null assertions in server code
tasks.description: About 181 by a rough grep, against the "narrow instead of !" rule in AGENTS.md.

milestones.title: M5: Docs and stale references
milestones.description: Guides and comments that no longer match the code.

tasks.title: Fix CLAUDE.md
tasks.description: It cites src/execution/factory.ts, which no longer exists, and says "three packages" while the root manifest lists seven workspace entries.

tasks.title: Fix AGENTS.md
tasks.description: It says "five workspace packages" and omits apps/vscode and apps/web.

tasks.title: Clean stale comments in the server
tasks.description: Kilo is still mentioned in 9 files and ADR-0017 in 21 (e.g. the tiers comment in mounts/usage.ts). The relay comment at index.ts:332 says it will be wired "when the SSE endpoints land", which they have.
